description: Enforce the pure make -> conda -> ansible bootstrap chain (GNU Make is the sole cold-start prerequisite; git/curl are deferred to Ansible; all Python/Ansible/app-dev installs including uv are done through Conda), add multi-variant Stow packages and the host interactive pre-Ansible wizard (make configure + scripts/devenv_wizard.py), and rework README.md so the tool chain, prerequisites, and packages are blindingly obvious.
goal:
Implement the pure `make -> conda -> ansible` bootstrap tool chain, multi-variant GNU Stow packages, host interactive pre-Ansible wizard, and comprehensive `README.md` rework:
1. PURE `make -> conda -> ansible` TOOL CHAIN (NO `git`, `curl`, OR `uv` COLD-START PREREQUISITE):
   - SOLE COLD-START PREREQUISITE (`GNU Make >= 3.81`): `make` MUST always be available for ANY action in `dev-env`. Do NOT require `git`, `curl`, or `uv` as cold-start prerequisites in `make check` (`git` and `curl` checks/installs are deferred to Ansible's `packages` role; `uv` is NOT required for installation at all and is installed purely for application development).
   - `make bootstrap` — Step 1 (Ensure Conda `~/miniforge3/bin/conda`): Define `CONDA_DIR ?= $(HOME)/miniforge3` and `CONDA ?= $(CONDA_DIR)/bin/conda`. If `$(CONDA)` is missing, resolve the platform Miniforge3 installer (`Miniforge3-MacOSX-arm64.sh`/`x86_64` on Darwin, `Miniforge3-Linux-aarch64.sh`/`x86_64` on Linux), download it from `https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/releases/latest/download/$$installer` using whichever fetcher exists (`curl`, `wget`, or system `python3` `urllib.request`) into `$$HOME/.cache/dev-env/`, and install Miniforge3 into `$(CONDA_DIR)` (`-b -u -p "$(CONDA_DIR)"`).
   - `make bootstrap` — Step 2 (Conda installs Ansible & Python bootstrap tooling): Run `"$(CONDA)" install -y -c conda-forge --override-channels python=3.13 ansible-core ansible-lint pyyaml`. Shim `$(CONDA_DIR)/bin/ansible-playbook`, `$(CONDA_DIR)/bin/ansible-galaxy`, and `$(CONDA_DIR)/bin/ansible-lint` into `~/.local/share/dev-env/bin/` (`$(PB)`, `$(GALAXY)`, `$(LINT)`), and install `community.general` via `$(GALAXY) collection install -r "$(SELF_DIR)/ansible/requirements.yml" --force`. NEVER use `curl https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh` or `uv tool install` anywhere in `Makefile`.
   - `make check` probes the chain clearly in dependency order: `GNU Make` (hard prerequisite) -> `OS` -> `apt` (Linux backend check) -> `conda` -> `ansible-core` -> `community.general` -> `stow` -> `brew` (macOS) -> `git`/`curl` (deferred to Ansible `packages` role, informational only so `make check` never fails if `git` or `curl` is absent).
   - Keep `Makefile` 100% GNU Make 3.81 compatible (no `.ONESHELL`, `$(file`, `!=`, `.RECIPEPREFIX`). Keep CI test commands (`make test`, `make test-all`) working cleanly on both Conda Python and CI `uv` runners.
   - `ansible/site.yml` & `ansible/roles/uv/tasks/main.yml`: Run `conda` BEFORE `uv` (`bootstrap -> homebrew -> packages -> dotfiles -> conda -> uv -> node -> neovim -> fish`). In `ansible/roles/uv/tasks/main.yml`, remove all `astral.sh/uv/install.sh` and `uv tool install` tasks; instead install `uv` and `devenv_uv_tools` (`ruff`, `pre-commit`) directly via Conda (`"{{ devenv_conda_dir }}/bin/conda" install -y -c conda-forge --override-channels uv {{ devenv_uv_tools | join(' ') }}`) purely as application-development tools for the user, and assert `{{ devenv_conda_dir }}/bin/uv` exists.
2. MULTI-VARIANT STOW PACKAGES (`devenv_package_variants`):
   - Declare `devenv_package_variants` in `ansible/group_vars/all.yml` mapping configurable tools (starting with `nvim`, extensible to other tools) to a default variant and Stow package directories:
     - `nvim-kickstart` (`dotfiles/nvim-kickstart/.config/nvim/...` — migrated from `dotfiles/nvim/`)
     - `nvim-minimal` (`dotfiles/nvim-minimal/.config/nvim/...` — lightweight built-in `vim.pack` config)
     - `nvim-lazyvim` (`dotfiles/nvim-lazyvim/.config/nvim/...` — LazyVim starter config)
   - Keep `devenv_stow_packages`, `devenv_links`, and `devenv_skip_links` (default `[]`) consistent across all declared variants.
   - In `ansible/roles/bootstrap/tasks/main.yml`, load `~/.config/dev-env/choices.yml` when present (`stat` + `ansible.builtin.include_vars`) while CI/non-interactive runs fall back to `group_vars/all.yml` defaults.
   - In `ansible/roles/dotfiles/tasks/main.yml` and `ansible/playbooks/unlink.yml`, unstow inactive variants (`stow --delete`) before stowing active packages (`stow --no-folding --restow`), and respect `devenv_skip_links`.
   - Update `ansible/roles/neovim/tasks/main.yml` so plugin checks respect the active `nvim` variant.
3. HOST INTERACTIVE PRE-ANSIBLE WIZARD (`scripts/devenv_wizard.py` & `Makefile`):
   - Implement `scripts/devenv_wizard.py` (Python 3.13, no `.sh` files) supporting `--non-interactive`, `--choices-file`, `--home`, and `--repo-root` flags, collecting all human-required decisions before Ansible runs:
     - Step A (OS / Distro & Backend Confirmation): detect OS, arch, Linux `/etc/os-release`, and package backend (`brew` / `apt`), confirm or override.
     - Step B (Stow Package Enablement & Config Distro / Variant Selection): select active Stow packages (`bash`, `conda`, `fish`, `nvim`, `tmux`, `zsh`) and multi-variant choices (`nvim`: `kickstart`, `minimal`, `lazyvim`) via `fzf` on TTY or numbered `/dev/tty` menu.
     - Step C (Interactive Dotfile Conflict Resolution & Merge): scan target paths in `$HOME`; when a regular file differs from the repo's Stow package file, prompt per file: `[d]` diff (`delta` / `diff -u`), `[m]` interactive merge (`nvim -d` / `$EDITOR -d` on `/dev/tty`, then back up `$HOME/<file>`), `[l]` extract to `.local` override (`~/.bashrc.local`, `~/.bash_profile.local`, `~/.zshrc.local`, `~/.config/fish/conf.d/99-local.fish`), `[a]` adopt into repo & back up `$HOME/<file>`, `[b]` back up `$HOME/<file>` & use repo version, `[s]` skip (`devenv_skip_links`).
     - Step D (Host Feature Flags & Runtime Pins): prompt for `devenv_set_login_shell`, `devenv_install_gui_casks` & `devenv_casks`, `devenv_remove_unmanaged` (when conflicting packages like `brew node`/`brew nvm` are detected), and confirm/override `devenv_python_version`, `devenv_conda_env_python`, `devenv_node_default_version`.
     - Step E (Persist Choices): write `~/.config/dev-env/choices.yml` (`0600`/`0644`).
   - Add `make configure` in `Makefile` running `$(CONDA_DIR)/bin/python3 scripts/devenv_wizard.py` (with fallback to `python3` if needed), and have `make install` run `configure` automatically on interactive TTYs (`[ -t 0 ]` and `CI != true`) when `~/.config/dev-env/choices.yml` is absent.
4. BLINDINGLY OBVIOUS TOOL CHAIN & COMPLETE PACKAGE INVENTORY IN `README.md`:
   - Put the **Chain of Tools & Execution Order** front and centre at the top of `README.md` (visual diagram + stage-by-stage table):
     - **Sole Prerequisite (`GNU Make >= 3.81`):** required for ANY action (`git`, `curl`, and `uv` are NOT cold-start prerequisites; `git` and `curl` are deferred to Ansible, and `uv` is purely an application-dev tool installed via Conda).
     - **Step 1 (`make bootstrap` -> Conda -> Ansible):** `make` installs **Conda** (`~/miniforge3`), and **Conda** installs `python=3.13`, `ansible-core`, `ansible-lint`, `pyyaml`, and `community.general`.
     - **Step 2 (`make configure` -> Interactive Wizard):** Conda Python runs `scripts/devenv_wizard.py` -> saves `~/.config/dev-env/choices.yml`.
     - **Step 3 (`make converge` -> Ansible):** Ansible runs `bootstrap` -> `homebrew`/`packages` (installs 22 CLI tools including `git`, `curl`, `stow`) -> `dotfiles` (requires `stow`; links via `stow --no-folding`) -> `conda` (`dev` env) -> `uv` (installs `uv`, `ruff`, `pre-commit` via Conda for app dev) -> `node` -> `neovim` -> `fish`.
   - Explicitly list all prerequisites by stage, valid bare-repo worktree clone commands (`dev-env/.git`, `dev-env/main`, `dev-env/<worktree>`), Quick Start & Day-to-Day commands, complete tables of all installed/configured packages (all 22 `devenv_packages_core` packages with `brew`/`apt` names & Stow status, runtimes & Conda-installed app-dev Python tools, Stow packages & variants, 3 Fish plugins, 26 locked Neovim plugins, GUI casks, purged duplicates), Interactive Setup & Merge guide, and Architecture/CI.
5. TESTS & WORLD DOCS:
   - Update `holon-config/world/ruleset.md` and `holon-config/world/constraints.md` to reflect pure `make -> conda -> ansible` bootstrap (removing the `uv tool install --python 3.13` rule so world rules match the new architecture), `scripts/devenv_wizard.py`, and `devenv_package_variants`.
   - Add unit tests in `tests/test_wizard.py` covering OS/distro detection & confirmation, variant resolution, conflict detection, diff/merge/local-extract/adopt/backup/skip flows, runtime pin & flag overrides, choices persistence, and non-interactive fallback.
   - Update `tests/test_manifest.py` and `tests/test_templating.py` to assert: (a) `astral.sh/uv/install.sh` and `uv tool install` do NOT appear in `Makefile` or `ansible/roles/uv/tasks/main.yml`, (b) `conda` runs before `uv` in `ansible/site.yml`, (c) `Makefile` `check` probes `GNU Make` and `conda` without failing when `git`/`curl`/`uv` are absent, (d) `devenv_package_variants` invariants across all variants, and (e) `README.md` names every prerequisite, core package, Conda app-dev Python tool (`uv`, `ruff`, `pre-commit`), Stow package/variant, Fish plugin, and Neovim plugin.
6. VERIFICATION:
   - `uv run --extra test pytest -m "not network"` (and verify `conda`/system python compatibility)
   - `uv run ruff check .`
   - `uv run --extra test ansible-lint ansible/site.yml`
   - `npx prettier --check "**/*.md"`
   - `make check`

description: Keep dev-env bootstrap as minimal as possible by fetching Miniforge3 using only curl, installing curl via brew (macOS) or apt (Linux) if missing, removing wget and python3 download fallbacks, and using apt everywhere instead of apt-get.
goal:
Simplify make bootstrap in dev-env to use only curl and apt (never apt-get, wget, or python3 download fallbacks):
1. MAKEFILE MINIMAL `curl`-ONLY & `apt`-ONLY BOOTSTRAP:
   - Replace all `apt-get` occurrences in `Makefile` with `apt` (lines 42 & 83 `apt install -y make`, and `check` probing `command -v apt >/dev/null 2>&1`).
   - In `Makefile` (`bootstrap` target), remove the `wget` and `python3 urllib.request` fallbacks completely.
   - When `$(CONDA)` is missing and `$$target` does not exist yet:
     - Check `command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1`.
     - If `curl` is missing:
       - On `Darwin`: locate `brew` (`/opt/homebrew/bin/brew`, `/usr/local/bin/brew`, or `command -v brew`) and run `"$$brew_bin" install curl` (failing with a clear message if Homebrew is missing).
       - On `Linux`: run `apt update && apt install -y curl` (with `sudo` if `$$(id -u) -ne 0`, or directly as root).
     - Download Miniforge3 using ONLY `curl`: `curl -fsSL "$$url" -o "$$target" || exit 1`.
   - In `Makefile` (`configure` target), require `"$(CONDA_DIR)/bin/python3"` (failing with `Run 'make bootstrap' first.` if absent) instead of falling back to host `python3`, keeping Python strictly Conda-owned.
   - Keep `Makefile` 100% GNU Make 3.81 compatible (tabs on recipes, no `.ONESHELL`, `$(file`, `!=`, `.RECIPEPREFIX`).
2. REPLACE `apt-get` IN `ansible/roles/packages/tasks/main.yml`:
   - Replace `'apt-get remove -y '` with `'apt remove -y '` on line 28.
3. UPDATE `README.md` & `holon-config/world/constraints.md`:
   - Update `README.md` (Step 1: `make bootstrap` diagram and text, plus any `apt-get` references) to state that `make bootstrap` installs `curl` via `brew` (macOS) or `apt` (Linux) if absent and fetches Miniforge3 using `curl` only, removing all mentions of `wget`, `python3 urllib`, and `apt-get`.
   - Replace `apt-get install` with `apt install` in `holon-config/world/constraints.md`.
4. TESTS (`tests/test_manifest.py`):
   - Add `test_makefile_bootstrap_uses_only_curl_and_installs_curl_via_brew_or_apt()` and `test_no_apt_get_in_repo()` asserting:
     - `wget` and `urllib.request` do NOT appear in `Makefile`,
     - `apt-get` does NOT appear anywhere in `Makefile`, `ansible/roles/packages/tasks/main.yml`, `README.md`, or `holon-config/world/constraints.md`,
     - `curl -fsSL`, `install curl`, and `apt install -y curl` are present in `Makefile`'s `bootstrap` target.
5. VERIFICATION:
   - `uv run --extra test pytest -m "not network"`
   - `uv run ruff check .`
   - `uv run --extra test ansible-lint ansible/site.yml`
   - `npx prettier --check "**/*.md"`

goal:

description: Robustly detect existing Conda and Ansible installations in Makefile and Ansible roles to prevent redundant installations, base environment reinstallation, or Python downgrades.
goal:
Ensure dev-env reliably detects, reuses, and never reinstalls or corrupts existing Conda or Ansible installations:
1. MAKEFILE ROBUST PATH & EXECUTABLE DETECTION:
   - Export extended PATH at the top of Makefile: `export PATH := /opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin:$(HOME)/.linuxbrew/bin:$(PATH)` so GNU Make recipes and subshells always find Homebrew/Linuxbrew tools.
   - Probe CONDA across `command -v conda` and standard locations (`/opt/homebrew/bin/conda`, `/usr/local/bin/conda`, `/opt/homebrew/Caskroom/miniforge/base/condabin/conda`, `/opt/homebrew/Caskroom/miniforge/base/bin/conda`, `/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/conda`, `$$HOME/.linuxbrew/bin/conda`, `$(HOME)/miniforge3/bin/conda`).
   - If CONDA executable exists, resolve CONDA_DIR dynamically via `$$CONDA info --base 2>/dev/null` (or directory fallback).
   - Probe PB (ansible-playbook), GALAXY (ansible-galaxy), and LINT (ansible-lint): if executable in `$(CONDA_DIR)/bin/`, reuse it; else if available on PATH via `command -v ansible-playbook` (e.g. `~/.local/bin/ansible-playbook`), reuse it; else fall back to `$(CONDA_DIR)/bin/ansible-playbook`.
   - In `bootstrap:` target:

description: Real non-check-mode Ansible converges (such as make install on WSL) fail at 'TASK [conda : Verify Conda activation in a clean Fish login shell]' with rc=1 and empty stderr while stdout prints the parent Makefile PATH instead of the clean Fish shell PATH. Root cause: ansible.builtin.command defaults to expand_argument_vars: true, which calls Python os.path.expandvars() on argv elements using ansible-playbook's own environment after shlex.split strips single quotes and before env -i runs. As a result, in all three clean-shell Conda verification tasks in ansible/roles/conda/tasks/main.yml (Fish, Zsh, Bash), $PATH (and $CONDA_DEFAULT_ENV in Fish) are expanded from ansible-playbook's parent environment: Fish passes one literal colon-joined PATH string to 'string join : $PATH' (performing zero joins and exiting rc=1), while Zsh and Bash silently assert against ansible-playbook's parent PATH instead of the clean shell PATH. Tests missed this because tests/test_shell_hooks.py ran subprocess.run directly rather than ansible-playbook and no hygiene rule checked expand_argument_vars on command tasks passing shell $VARs. Planning requirement: the Stage 2 plan document MUST include an explicit '## Touch Set' section listing every file path to create or modify (one repo-relative path per bullet).
goal: 1) Fix `ansible/roles/conda/tasks/main.yml`: add `expand_argument_vars: false` under `ansible.builtin.command:` for all three clean-shell verification tasks (`Verify Conda activation in a clean Fish login shell`, `Verify Conda activation in a clean Zsh login interactive shell`, and `Verify Conda activation in a clean Bash login interactive shell`), and update the Fish command to use `string join : -- $PATH` defensively so no PATH entry starting with '-' can be misinterpreted as a flag. 2) Strengthen `tests/test_toolchain.py`: in `test_ansible_static_task_hygiene()`, strip Jinja `{{ ... }}` blocks from each `ansible.builtin.command.cmd` string and whenever the remaining command string contains a shell variable reference matching `r"\$[A-Za-z_{]"`, assert `cmd_block.get("expand_argument_vars") is False`. 3) Strengthen `tests/test_shell_hooks.py`: (a) in `test_conda_role_clean_env_shell_verification_tasks()`, assert `verify_task['ansible.builtin.command'].get('expand_argument_vars') is False` for all three shells (fish, zsh, bash) and assert `'string join : -- $PATH'` appears in the Fish verification task `cmd`; (b) add `test_ansible_conda_clean_env_shell_verification_playbook(tmp_path: Path)` that resolves `ansible-playbook` (`Path(sys.executable).parent / 'ansible-playbook'` or `shutil.which('ansible-playbook')`; fail closed in CI when `CI == 'true'` and `HOLON_IN_SANDBOX != '1'`, otherwise skip if absent), builds a hermetic fake HOME via `_build_hermetic_conda_and_nvm_home(tmp_path)`, extracts the actual clean-shell verification and assert tasks (from `Check if fish is available for Conda clean-shell verification` onward) from `ansible/roles/conda/tasks/main.yml`, writes a temporary playbook in `tmp_path` (`hosts: localhost`, `connection: local`, `gather_facts: true`, `vars_files: [str(REPO_ROOT / 'ansible' / 'group_vars' / 'all.yml')]`, plus the extracted tasks), and executes `ansible-playbook` with `-e devenv_home=<fake_home> -e devenv_conda_dir=<fake_home>/miniforge3` (deliberately omitting `-e devenv_user=...` so `group_vars/all.yml` resolution is also exercised) and a polluted parent environment (`PATH='/fake/polluted/makefile/path:' + os.environ.get('PATH', '')`, `CONDA_DEFAULT_ENV='POLLUTED_PARENT_ENV'`). Assert `proc.returncode == 0`, zero `[DEPRECATION WARNING]` in stderr, that the Bash assert task ran (`'Assert Conda function, default env, and PATH in Bash' in proc.stdout`), and when `fish` / `zsh` are present (using `_require_shell` enforcement in CI when `CI == 'true'` and `HOLON_IN_SANDBOX != '1'`) that the Fish and Zsh assert tasks also ran cleanly without failing on the polluted parent PATH or CONDA_DEFAULT_ENV. 4) Keep `tests/test_manifest.py` untouched (<= 1,000 lines), `tests/test_templating.py` untouched, and zero `.sh` files outside `dotfiles/examples/`. 5) Validate with `uv run --extra test pytest -m "not network"`, `uv run --extra test ruff format --check .`, `uv run --extra test ruff check .`, `uv run --extra test ansible-lint`, `npx --yes prettier@3 --check "**/*.md"`, and `make check-syntax`.
rationale: Fixes the live WSL/real-converge failure in the Fish clean-shell Conda check, stops Zsh and Bash clean-shell checks from silently testing Ansible's parent PATH instead of the isolated shell PATH, and adds both a static hygiene guard and a real hermetic ansible-playbook integration test so ansible.builtin.command runtime bugs cannot escape CI again.

description: Two dev-env Linux/WSL and NVM parity bugs: (1) zsh is missing from devenv_packages_core and ansible/vars/pkg_apt.yml; macOS ships /bin/zsh by default while Ubuntu/WSL does not, so dev-env stows ~/.zshrc without installing zsh on Linux/WSL. (2) NVM storage has a broken bi-directional symlink bridge and recursive symlink bug: dotfiles/fish/.config/fish/conf.d/00-devenv.fish uses 'find "$XDG_DATA_HOME/nvm" -maxdepth 1 -name "v*"', which matches the 'versions' directory itself and creates a recursive symlink ~/.local/share/nvm/versions/node/versions -> ~/.local/share/nvm/versions; meanwhile mirroring ~/.local/share/nvm/v* <-> ~/.local/share/nvm/versions/node/v* causes 'nvm uninstall <ver>' in Bash/Fish to delete only the symlink under versions/node/ while leaving the real directory under ~/.local/share/nvm/vX.Y.Z, so 'nvm ls' still lists the version while 'nvm uninstall' fails with 'N/A version is not installed...' and Fish recreates the deleted symlink on next startup. Additionally, ansible/roles/node/tasks/main.yml still points creates and the 'current' symlink at the legacy flat ~/.local/share/nvm/v<ver> path instead of the unified ~/.local/share/nvm/versions/node/v<ver> directory shared by both nvm.fish (nvm_data) and nvm-sh. (d) if `test -L "$XDG_DATA_HOME/nvm/current"; and not test -e "$XDG_DATA_HOME/nvm/current"` and `test -d "$nvm_data/v$devenv_node_default_version"`, repair `current` via `ln -sfn "$nvm_data/v$devenv_node_default_version" "$XDG_DATA_HOME/nvm/current"`; (e) never create back-symlinks under `$XDG_DATA_HOME/nvm/v*`. 4) Update tests: (a) in `tests/test_manifest.py` (strictly keep `<= 1,000` lines, currently 990), update `test_fish_nvm_path_resolution_in_conf_d()` to assert `v[0-9]*`, assert `-name "v*"` is absent, assert `versions/node/$vname` is not back-symlinked into `$XDG_DATA_HOME/nvm/$vname`, and retain `set -g nvm_data $XDG_DATA_HOME/nvm/versions/node` and `fish_add_path -gpPm "$XDG_DATA_HOME/nvm/current/bin"`; (b) in `tests/test_toolchain.py`, add tests asserting `zsh` is in `devenv_packages_core`, mapped to `zsh` in `pkg_apt.yml`, and skipped in `os_Darwin.yml` `devenv_pkg_skip` (not skipped in `os_Linux.yml`), and asserting `ansible/roles/node/tasks/main.yml` points `creates` and `current` symlink `src` at `{{ devenv_home }}/.local/share/nvm/versions/node/v{{ devenv_node_version }}`;
